subject.title: fix(web): apply Control UI text size to content typography

question: Are the four supplied desktop and mobile screenshots representative enough to accept the remaining typography-reflow risk across the unshown dense Control UI surfaces?
rationale: The implementation, focused regression coverage, screenshots, and exact-head checks are strong, but repository-wide visual reflow is an acceptance judgment that automated checks cannot fully settle.

options.title: Accept representative proof
options.body: Merge because the exact-head screenshots demonstrate the intended behavior without visible breakage on representative desktop and mobile layouts.

options.title: Request dense-surface proof
options.body: Ask for S and XXL screenshots of chat/sidebar, Sessions, Skills, terminal, or workboard before merging.

recommendation.title: Accept representative proof
recommendation.body: Merge because the exact-head screenshots demonstrate the intended behavior without visible breakage on representative desktop and mobile layouts.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged history most directly connects this owner to introducing the text-size feature and maintaining the affected appearance, config, dashboard, and usage styling.
